name: exec
description: Sandboxed code/shell execution tool plugin (R3): exec_run proposes a command (NEVER executes) and exec_approve runs the exact stored command in a throwaway, network-isolated docker container (uid nobody, all capabilities dropped, read-only rootfs, cpu/mem/pids bounds, minimal env). Per-run explicit approval gate with an operator-held key ($secret:EXEC_APPROVAL_KEY), TTL-bound single-use requests, audit log, cap + spill output. NO production access by design: --network none means the payload cannot reach production containers, the DB or any network.

config_schema.label: Approval mode
config_schema.description: require (default) = every run needs an explicit approval; deny = plugin is inert and refuses everything

config_schema.label: Approval key
config_schema.description: Operator-held secret that exec_approve must match to execute a request. Reference the secret by name: set to $secret:EXEC_APPROVAL_KEY. Empty = nothing can ever be approved (plugin inert).

config_schema.label: Approval request TTL (seconds)
config_schema.description: How long a pending exec_run request stays approvable (clamped 60-3600)

config_schema.label: Sandbox image
config_schema.description: Pinned docker image the sandboxed command runs in (must already exist on the host; the plugin never pulls). Example: omniagent-dev:latest in omnidev. Empty = execution denied.

config_schema.label: Default run timeout (seconds)
config_schema.description: Default per-run timeout when a call omits timeout_secs (clamped 1-300)

config_schema.label: Inline output cap (chars)
config_schema.description: Inline result cap; larger outputs are spilled to a file whose path is reported first (clamped 1000-50000)

config_schema.label: Captured output hard cap (bytes)
config_schema.description: Total captured output before the run is killed and truncation is reported (clamped 65536-16777216)

config_schema.label: Spill/state directory
config_schema.description: Directory for output spill files and approval-request state. Point at a host-visible path under the deployment data dir (e.g. /opt/omni/data/exec). Empty = system temp dir.

config_schema.label: Sandbox CPU limit
config_schema.description: docker --cpus limit for the sandbox container

config_schema.label: Sandbox memory limit
config_schema.description: docker --memory limit for the sandbox container
